summary: Pass. I read leaf.md (213 lines) in full, VIEW_ARCH.md in full (190 lines, the complete decoded /arch string, consistent with the truncated AUTHOR_INPUT.json prefix), all other VIEW_* files (each matching its JSON pointer in AUTHOR_INPUT.json), REVIEW_SCOPE.md, AUTHOR_INPUT.json, acceptance/README.md, acceptance/probe.py (550 lines) and all eight pinned upstream files at the exact bytes of input.inventory. All 26 author observations were checked line-by-line against the fixed upstream source and every claim (line range, method name, field names, quoted strings, transaction semantics) holds; the one nuance is observation 9, whose docblock quote sits at ColumnModel.php:218-224 immediately above the cited 225-228 body, which does not change the substance. Design/inference separation is explicit and honoured: upstream observations stay upstream, the Python/SQLite target design is labelled as inference, and no upstream code, schema or runtime behaviour is asserted. Scope matches the leaf's defining core (board, columns, cards, position-as-state) and the pinned P0 scenario (local single-user, named boards, user-named ordered columns, title+short-description cards, cross-column move and in-column reorder, restart persistence, per-column lists and counts) while explicitly rejecting accounts, collaboration, a status field, WIP limits, notifications, time reports and automation at the API boundary (FORBIDDEN_FIELD), with the leaf's standard/optional layers declared out of scope. The journey is end-to-end (workflow steps 1-9 from process start to restart to probe). Architecture, API surface, validation bounds, error codes (all probe-asserted codes appear in VIEW_ARCH.md section 5), timestamp/date rules and decisions D1-D8 are explicit and mutually consistent with the probe's assertions (board/card length bounds 120/200/500, 201/204/303/400/404/409/422 codes, created_at<=updated_at/moved_at, contiguous 1..N renumbering on both columns). The probe's negative cases are meaningful: every rejection asserts an exact status plus error code, and every rejected write is accompanied by a state re-read proving no write (board_state() comparison in A02/A04, board-state before/after in A03, board-list growth in A01). No upstream execution or certification is claimed: gaps 0-3, the inference field, acceptance item 8 and README's Verification status all state not_run for both the target and upstream, and the restart check is explicitly an operator procedure. Limits are explicit and honest (12 gaps covering unverified restart, no UI/HTML assertions, no drag-and-drop, no auth/TLS, single-threaded server, destructive deletion without undo, no per-column history, licence scope). Two non-blocking prose imprecisions in the acceptance prose are worth noting for a future edit but do not affect correctness: acceptance item 4 says 'every rejected request ... is followed by a re-read ... (board_state() comparison)', whereas the probe batches the 12 A03 create rejections into one before/after comparison, uses a list-length check for A01's rejections and a card-order check for A03's two PATCH rejections, and omits a re-read after A04's unknown-card 404; and the A03 case summary counts '12 rejected writes' while two further PATCH rejections are also asserted in that case. The substantive zero-write guarantee for every rejected write still holds in each case.
